business_summary: Jiangsu Xiechang Electronic Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of motion control products and power chips. It also provides power semiconductor packaging and testing services. The company was formerly known as Jiangsu Xiechang Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Jiangsu Xiechang Electronic Technology Group Co., Ltd. in January 2024. Jiangsu Xiechang Electronic Technology Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2011 and is based in Zhangjiagang, China.
business_summary_ko: Jiangsu Xiechang Electronic Technology Group Co., Ltd.는 모션 제어 제품 및 파워 칩의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 전력 반도체 패키징 및 테스트 서비스도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Jiangsu Xiechang Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd로 알려졌으며 2024년 1월에 Jiangsu Xiechang Electronic Technology Group Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Jiangsu Xiechang Electronic Technology Group Co., Ltd.는 2011년에 설립되었으며 중국 장가항에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
